entries.title: Moderators of HN: please stop changing post titles
entries.author: there
entries.current_title: Moderators of HN: please stop changing post titles
entries.excerpt: I would ask that the unknown mysterious moderators of this site stop changing post titles long after they hit the front page. The guidelines at http://ycombinator.com/newsguidelines.html state: "You can make up a new title if you want, but if you put gratuitous editorial spin on it, the editors may rewrite it." but this should not apply just because the title submitted does not match the article. entries.title: Ask HN: How to setup a company in U.S. without being there?
entries.author: ahmedaly
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to setup a company in U.S. without being there?
entries.excerpt: Hi guys, I am working on a startup, and I will need to charge users for my services. I am in Egypt, and its not possible to have an international merchant account, or in other words, its very expensive.. So I would like to know, how can I setup a tax ID and EIN or whatever, so I can make a merchant account based in U.S.? Is it possible to do that without having to be physically in the U.S.? Are there any companies that help do that? Thanks so much in advance.
entries.guide_zh: 人在埃及却需要国际收款，作者求助如何不赴美也能设立美国公司。

entries.title: Ask HN: Best setups to avoid availability outages on AWS
entries.author: richardv
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Best setups to avoid availability outages on AWS
entries.excerpt: Using only AWS services, what do you put in place to help prevent disruptions when a single availability zone goes down? The most simple would be to set up your instances in a multiple AZ's and then configure the ELB to round robin requests until the health of one of the instances is poor. Any other thoughts?
entries.guide_zh: 仅使用 AWS 服务，怎样安排架构才能降低单个可用区故障的影响？
